0070515598d7.name: Glory in Honour
0070515598d7.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your HOUSE TERRYN models is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, its Attacks characteristic goes up by 1, and you can re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever it makes a melee attack.

00b9a4ca5cd6.name: Our Darkest Hour
00b9a4ca5cd6.plain: Once per battle, in any phase, when one of your HOUSE TARANIS CHARACTER models is destroyed without exploding: mark the centre of where its base was with a marker on the battlefield. At the end of the phase, you may roll one D6 in place of any rules that trigger when that model is destroyed (apart from Explodes, which you must roll for first). If you do, on a 4+ put the model back on the battlefield as near as possible to the marker, within 6" of it but outside Engagement Range of all enemy models, with 3 wounds left. If the model can't be placed, it is destroyed. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

02040b019f64.name: Protect Those in Need
02040b019f64.plain:
Selfless Heroes: this model can perform Heroic Interventions as if it were a CHARACTER, and with more range and a longer move if it is one.
- If this model is a CHARACTER, it can perform a Heroic Intervention while within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of any enemy units, rather than 3" horizontally and 5" vertically, and each of its Heroic Intervention moves can be up to 6".
- Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

0852aef5b6b8.name: Lay Low The Tyrants
0852aef5b6b8.plain: Martial Pride: when this model is chosen to shoot or fight, you can re-roll a single hit roll or a single wound roll for it.

0a628740be6c.name: Pack Tactics
0a628740be6c.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, choose an enemy unit that has 2 or more of your ARMIGER-CLASS models within Engagement Range of it. For the rest of the phase, each of your ARMIGER-CLASS models that was in Engagement Range of that unit when the phase started gets 1 added to its Attacks characteristic.

13fb11e09a27.name: A Squire’s Duty
13fb11e09a27.plain: When one of your ARMIGER CLASS models Falls Back in your Movement phase, you can use this Stratagem: that model can still shoot and charge this turn despite having Fallen Back.

140516d314a4.name: Machine Spirit Resurgent
140516d314a4.plain: In your Command phase, choose one of your QUESTOR MECHANICUS models. Up to the start of your next Command phase, when working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat it as if it had all of its wounds left. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

16bf0f034d36.name: Survivors of Strife
16bf0f034d36.plain: In any phase, when one of your ARMIGER-CLASS models is chosen as the target of an attack: for the rest of the phase, any attack made against that model fails to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.

192500686b9b.name: Chainbreaker
192500686b9b.plain: When CANIS REX attacks a unit that is not IMPERIUM, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores one extra hit.

19a686e74af6.name: Errant's Duty (Bondsman)
19a686e74af6.plain: During your Command phase, choose one friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model that is within 12" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, that ARMIGER-CLASS model can declare a charge in a turn when it Advanced, and Advance and charge rolls made for it get 1 added.

1b21634634b9.name: Staunch Allies
1b21634634b9.plain: In the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase, before any other Heroic Interventions are made: choose one of your HOUSE HAWKSHROUD models, plus one enemy unit that made a charge move this phase and is within 12" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model. Your model is eligible to perform a Heroic Intervention, and when it makes a Heroic Intervention move this phase it can move up to 6+D6", as long as it finishes within Engagement Range of the chosen enemy unit. Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies. If your model does perform a Heroic Intervention, it can fight first in the following Fight phase.

21c08eee0a5d.name: Refuse No Challenge
21c08eee0a5d.plain: Noble Display: add 1 to the hit rolls of this model's melee attacks in a turn in which it made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention.

252c9868c03d.name: Benevolence of the Machine God
252c9868c03d.plain: In any phase, when one of your QUESTOR MECHANICUS models would lose a wound because of a mortal wound: for the rest of the phase, roll one D6 each time that model would lose a wound to a mortal wound; on a 5+, the wound is not lost.

26f5fd7264a1.name: Strength from Exile
26f5fd7264a1.plain: When one of your FREEBLADE LANCE models is chosen to shoot in your Shooting phase, or chosen to fight in the Fight phase: for the rest of the phase, as long as no friendly models are within 12" of it, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1 each time it attacks.

28a58fec2a92.name: Hunters of the Foe
28a58fec2a92.plain:
Melee attacks by a model with this tradition re-roll wound rolls of 1, unless the target contains any VEHICLE or MONSTER models.
- If the target contained 6 or more models when this model was chosen to fight, you can re-roll the attack's wound roll.

29d6ca53b73a.name: Rolling Thunder
29d6ca53b73a.plain: In your Charge phase, once one of your HOUSE RAVEN models (other than an ARMIGER CLASS model) has finished a charge move: until the turn ends, any enemy model within 3" of that HOUSE RAVEN model subtracts 1 from the hit roll of each attack it makes.

2c9ccfd73d6c.name: Steel-sinewed Aim
2c9ccfd73d6c.plain: When a model with this Martial Tradition makes a ranged attack against an enemy unit within Engagement Range of its own unit, add 1 to that attack's roll.

2ca35fdb3454.name: Machine Focus
2ca35fdb3454.plain: When a model with this Martial Tradition is chosen to shoot, you can re-roll a single wound roll or a single Damage roll for it.

2d18d3b736ed.name: Brothers and Sisters in Burden
2d18d3b736ed.plain: In your Command phase, if your army is Dishonoured, choose one of your FREEBLADE LANCE CHARACTER models. It has the following ability until your next Command phase starts. Brothers and Sisters in Burden (Aura): the Honoured Chivalric ability of your chosen Oaths stays active for this WARLORD while any friendly FREEBLADE LANCE model is within 12" of this CHARACTER. As a result, the Chivalric abilities active for these models may differ from those active for your other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models.

2d7b126567b5.name: Blessed Arms
2d7b126567b5.plain:
A model with this Martial Tradition adds 6" to the Range characteristic of its ranged weapons and upgrades its Cognis heavy stubbers.
- Each Cognis heavy stubber it is equipped with becomes Assault 6, and its Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1.

2dc975b81e10.name: Siege Claw
2dc975b81e10.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks made with this weapon. If such an attack targets a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, add 2 to its Damage characteristic.

2e4928c2043a.name: Crimson Wall
2e4928c2043a.plain: In the Fight phase, when a melee attack is allocated to one of your HOUSE RAVEN CHARACTER models, the saving throw against it is not rolled; it is treated as a 6 automatically.

3017ffc6e352.name: Omnissiah's Grace
3017ffc6e352.plain: Roll one D6 for each wound a model with this tradition loses, except wounds lost to mortal wounds; on a 6, that wound isn't lost.

3373cc5fd42f.name: Defend the Realm
3373cc5fd42f.plain: Duty and Honour: this model gains Objective Secured, or if it already has it, counts as 3 extra models when working out control of an objective marker.

341f29b07da7.name: Sacristan Pledge
341f29b07da7.plain: A model with this Questor Allegiance Oath adds 1 to its Wounds characteristic (2 if TITANIC) and regains 1 lost wound at the start of your Command phases.

3662dddf30f1.name: Knight of the Iron Cog
3662dddf30f1.plain: This unit has the Canticles of the Omnissiah ability, and counts as having the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword for that ability.

3bcd911818ae.name: Bondsman Abilities
3bcd911818ae.plain: If your army is Honoured or Virtuous, then while an ARMIGER-CLASS model is under the effect of a Bondsman Ability, it also gets this on top of any other effects: each time an attack is allocated to it, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (minimum 1).

3d2dfcef9c29.name: Hurled Wreckage
3d2dfcef9c29.plain: At the end of the Fight phase, choose one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models equipped with Freedom's Hand or a thunderstrike gauntlet (or a Relic replacing either). If any VEHICLE or MONSTER model was destroyed during that phase while within Engagement Range of your model, you can pick one enemy unit that is visible to it and within 9" of it, and that isn't within Engagement Range of any of your units. Roll one D6; subtract 1 from the roll if the chosen unit is a CHARACTER whose Wounds characteristic is 9 or less. On a 3-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and on a 6 it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

3f882779b05f.name: Horrors at Bay
3f882779b05f.plain: In the Fight phase, when an enemy unit is chosen to fight while it is within Engagement Range of one of your HOUSE RAVEN models: for the rest of the phase, the only models in that unit that can make close combat attacks against your HOUSE RAVEN model are those within Engagement Range of it. For example, models in that unit that aren't in Engagement Range of your model but are within 1/2" of a model that is within 1/2" can't attack it in close combat, though they may still attack other eligible targets in close combat.

499dfbb7728b.name: Vow of Honour
499dfbb7728b.plain:
A model with this Questor Allegiance Oath adds 1 to its Advance and charge rolls and can ignore any or all modifiers to them.
- Each time it makes a pile-in move or consolidation move, it can move 1" further.

4adea4d4bed7.name: Refuse No Challenge
4adea4d4bed7.plain: Gain 1 Honour point at the end of each battle round in which melee attacks by your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units destroyed 2 or more enemy units.

4b723fdc31df.name: Rotate Ion Shields
4b723fdc31df.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS VEHICLE models is chosen as the target of a ranged attack: for the rest of the phase, that model gets a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

4f1036d7b8ce.name: Noble Combatants
4f1036d7b8ce.plain:
When a model with this Martial Tradition fights, it can make extra attacks equal to the number of its attacks that didn't reach the Inflict Damage step.
- This only applies if all of its attacks in that fight target one enemy unit and none of them use the Sweep profile of a melee weapon.
- The extra attacks are made once all of those attacks have been resolved, against that same enemy unit, and they can't use a melee weapon's Sweep profile either.

5400e6f62598.name: Defend the Realm
5400e6f62598.plain: At the end of the battle round, you gain 1 Honour point if you controlled more objective markers than your opponent did when your turn ended.

57e520eae895.name: Dragon Slayer
57e520eae895.plain: When one of your HOUSE GRIFFITH models is chosen to shoot in your Shooting phase or to fight in the Fight phase: for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of each attack that model makes against a target containing any VEHICLE or MONSTER models.

5b0d5ae7f432.name: Refuse No Challenge
5b0d5ae7f432.plain: Mighty Display: you may re-roll this model's Advance rolls and charge rolls.

5d3dc58ddd26.name: Crushed
5d3dc58ddd26.plain: Use in the Fight phase when an attack made by an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army with Freedom's Hand or a thunderstrike gauntlet (or a Relic replacing either) is allocated to an enemy model. Before any saving throw is made for that attack, both players roll off; add 1 to your result if this IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model's Strength characteristic is higher than that of the model the attack was allocated to. If you win, invulnerable saving throws can't be taken against that attack; if not, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

5f682fdcc643.name: Thundercoil Harpoon
5f682fdcc643.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks made with this weapon against MONSTER or VEHICLE units (but not AIRCRAFT). Whenever an attack from this profile is allocated to a model, the unit of that model also suffers 3 mortal wounds besides the normal damage.

601981c8a7a9.name: Crusader's Duty (Bondsman)
601981c8a7a9.plain: During your Command phase, choose one friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model that is within 12" of this model. Its Ballistic Skill characteristic is improved by 1 until your next Command phase starts.

6704cc2f2927.name: Close-Quarters Killers
6704cc2f2927.plain: Re-roll a hit roll of 1 for every melee attack made by a model with this tradition.

698b736fdfe3.name: Twin Icarus Autocannon
698b736fdfe3.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made against an AIRCRAFT unit.

6b4f9a01cdcd.name: Honour Inviolate
6b4f9a01cdcd.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your HOUSE RAVEN models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, as long as it did not Advance, its ranged weapons get 1 added to their Strength characteristic. This costs 3CP for an ACASTUS CLASS or DOMINUS CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

6d68325e5ca8.name: Glorified History
6d68325e5ca8.plain:
Pick House Terryn, House Griffith, House Cadmus, House Mortan or House Hawkshroud, and use its Household Tradition and Noble Household Stratagems.
- If a CHARACTER model with this Martial Tradition is given a Warlord Trait, it can take a Noble Household Warlord Trait from the household you picked.

6de8c00c0d9e.name: Saturation Bombardment
6de8c00c0d9e.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your HOUSE VULKER models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for its ranged attacks scores one additional hit. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

6fd171431903.name: Skyfire Protocols
6fd171431903.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your ARMIGER-CLASS models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, its attacks against AIRCRAFT units get 1 added to their hit rolls.

6fe2fc33067b.name: Thunderstomp
6fe2fc33067b.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC models is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, its melee attacks with its titanic feet have 1 subtracted from their hit rolls, and if such an attack hits a target that isn't a VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER unit, it inflicts 2 mortal wounds on the target and the attack sequence ends.

70590ed15a85.name: Kolossi Eternal
70590ed15a85.plain: Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one HOUSE RAVEN model from your army (not an ARMIGER CLASS model), then pick two other HOUSE RAVEN models within 3" of it. Until the end of the phase, while those two models stay within 3" of the first model, all three have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

7063c87e7807.name: Hekaton Siege Claw (Crush)
7063c87e7807.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of attacks made with this weapon. If such an attack targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 2 to its Damage characteristic.

71b20f1d250c.name: Protect Those in Need
71b20f1d250c.plain:
Gain 1 Honour point at the end of a battle round in which your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS made a Heroic Intervention or charged an enemy already fighting your units. In detail, either or both of these must have happened that round:
- One of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models performed a Heroic Intervention.
- One of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models made a charge move against an enemy unit that was already within Engagement Range of another friendly unit at the start of the Charge phase.

71f2493a44c7.name: Order of Companions
71f2493a44c7.plain: Use before the battle while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the HOUSE RAVEN keyword. Pick one HOUSE RAVEN QUESTORIS-CLASS model from your army; it gains this ability. Order of Companions: each time this model is chosen to shoot or fight, while resolving its attacks you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or damage roll. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

73e440b8a45a.name: Point Blank Barrage
73e440b8a45a.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, it can make attacks with Blast weapons against units within its Engagement Range, and for each such attack against a unit within its Engagement Range, an unmodified hit roll of 1 causes this model to suffer 1 mortal wound after all its attacks have been resolved.

79921f410338.name: Front-line Fighters
79921f410338.plain: Ranged attacks made by a model with this Martial Tradition get 1 added to their Strength characteristic when the target is within 18" of the model.

79955d52443a.name: Pains of Old Night
79955d52443a.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, you re-roll a wound roll of 1 for its attacks against CHAOS models.

83f3be23139e.name: Chainsweep
83f3be23139e.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models carrying a reaper chainsword or reaper chain-cleaver (or a Relic that takes the place of one) is chosen to fight: for the rest of the phase, hit rolls for that model's attacks can never be re-rolled, but each attack it makes with the Sweep profile of one of those weapons (or of such a Relic) makes 1 extra hit roll.

84a387265c85.name: Relentless Advance
84a387265c85.plain:
After a Normal Move or Advance in your Movement phase, a model with this tradition shoots as if it had Remained Stationary until your Shooting phase ends.
- Until then, it can also ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and its Advance rolls.

86f471e61f22.name: Paragons of Honour
86f471e61f22.plain:
In an army that is all IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, you must swear one extra Oath after your army's 2 Oaths, for your models with this Martial Tradition.
- This applies if every unit in your army has the IMPERIAL KNIGHTS keyword (ignoring units with the AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or UNALIGNED keywords) and any of your models have this Martial Tradition. The extra Oath applies to every model in your army with this Martial Tradition.

9169947238a1.name: Thin Their Ranks
9169947238a1.plain: At the start of the Shooting phase, choose up to 3 of your ARMIGER-CLASS models. For the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a ranged attack by one of those models wounds the target automatically.

940894213906.name: Defend the Realm
940894213906.plain: You lose 1 Honour point at the end of the battle round if you controlled fewer objective markers when your turn ended than when it began.

944b618862b0.name: Lay Low The Tyrants
944b618862b0.plain: Martial Legacy: once per battle round, you can change one Advance roll, hit roll, wound roll or saving throw for one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models to a 6.

9646633a9ac5.name: Code Chivalric
9646633a9ac5.plain: If every unit in your army has the IMPERIAL KNIGHTS keyword (not counting any AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM or UNALIGNED units), and, FREEBLADES aside, all of them come from the same noble household, you must swear 2 Oaths from the Oath tables when you write your army list and record them on it. You begin the battle with 1 Honour point. During the battle you can gain Honour points (usually by fulfilling the Pledge of your chosen Oaths) and lose them (usually when the Troth of your chosen Oaths applies), but your total can't drop below 0 or rise above 6. At the start of each battle round, check your total to find your army's level of Honour: 0 points is Dishonoured, 1-4 is Honoured, and 5-6 is Virtuous. Models with this ability gain Chivalric abilities based on that level. While Dishonoured, neither the Honoured nor the Virtuous Chivalric abilities of your chosen Oaths are active. While Honoured, the Honoured Chivalric ability of your chosen Oaths is active for every IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in your army, but the Virtuous ones are not. While Virtuous, both the Honoured and Virtuous Chivalric abilities of your chosen Oaths are active for every IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in your army.

waive.ARMY HONOUR NUMBER OF HONOUR POINTS: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

97b8f73126e6.name: Cold Fury
97b8f73126e6.plain: A melee attack by a model with this tradition automatically wounds on an unmodified hit roll of 6, or on an unmodified hit roll of 5+ if the target is TITANIC.

985eaa4350af.name: Exacting Charge
985eaa4350af.plain: In your Charge phase, once one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS VEHICLE models has finished a charge move, choose one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll four D6s (six D6s if this model is TITANIC). That unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each result equal to or greater than its Toughness characteristic, or 2 mortal wounds instead for each unmodified 6. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

9a4c37fdced3.name: Recount the Virtues
9a4c37fdced3.plain: At the start of any of your phases except your Command phase, choose one of your MENTOR units that hasn't recounted a teaching this turn. It can recount one teaching that no friendly model has recounted yet this turn; that teaching is automatically inspiring (no roll is made) and lasts until your next Command phase starts.

9bba5463f362.name: Indomitable Heroes
9bba5463f362.plain: A model with this Martial Tradition heals 1 lost wound at the start of your Command phases and can ignore any or all modifiers to its Advance and charge rolls.

9d92e209855e.name: Gallant Warriors
9d92e209855e.plain: When you make an Advance roll or charge roll for a model with this tradition, roll one extra D6, then discard one of the dice.

9ec4a67ffbd7.name: Strike and Shield
9ec4a67ffbd7.plain:
Melee attacks against a model with this Martial Tradition always miss on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3, and their Armour Penetration of -1 becomes 0.
- The 1-3 rule applies whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.
- A melee attack with an Armour Penetration characteristic of -1 that is allocated to such a model is treated as having an Armour Penetration characteristic of 0 instead.

9ed69a07f386.name: Legendary Knight
9ed69a07f386.plain: A FREEBLADE LANCE CHARACTER can take one Exalted Court upgrade, despite being a FREEBLADE.

9f10dc7f1d01.name: Lockstep Advance
9f10dc7f1d01.plain: When you choose one of your HOUSE RAVEN units to move in your Movement phase: until the turn ends, its Move characteristic is halved, but whenever this model fires a weapon with a random number of attacks (for example 2D6), roll one extra dice when finding out how many attacks it makes, then discard one of the dice. This costs 3CP for an ACASTUS CLASS or DOMINUS CLASS model and 1CP for any other model.

9f6e90c416fd.name: Slayers of Shadows
9f6e90c416fd.plain: When one of your HOUSE MORTAN models is chosen to shoot in your Shooting phase or to fight in the Fight phase: for the rest of the phase, whenever that model attacks, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the hit roll, Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill.

a07fc71c8558.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
a07fc71c8558.plain: At the start of your Movement phase, choose up to two of your ARMIGER-CLASS models that are within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 6" away from every enemy model. If the mission you are playing uses the Strategic Reserves rule, put that unit into Strategic Reserves; it can't then arrive from Strategic Reserves in the turn it was put there.

a2c7f3f5ba9a.name: Lay Low The Tyrants
a2c7f3f5ba9a.plain: You lose 1 Honour point if your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units destroyed fewer than 2 enemy units with their attacks during that battle round.

a4876cf0fb79.name: Sir Hekhtur
a4876cf0fb79.plain: If CANIS REX is destroyed and does not explode, before removing it, set up SIR HEKHTUR within 3" of CANIS REX, treating him as a passenger disembarking from a destroyed TRANSPORT. If he survives, SIR HEKHTUR then uses his own profile and keywords. He is armed with Hekhtur's pistol, but he does not have the Ion Shields or Super-heavy Walker abilities. The unit only counts as destroyed once SIR HEKHTUR has also been destroyed.

a49f731b2f8f.name: Calculated Targeting
a49f731b2f8f.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your QUESTOR MECHANICUS models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, an unmodified wound roll of 6 for any of its ranged attacks inflicts mortal wounds on the target equal to that attack's Damage characteristic, and the attack sequence ends. This costs 2CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model, 3CP for a QUESTORIS-CLASS model, and 4CP for any other model.

a6e2eb8dcb00.name: Warden's Duty (Bondsman)
a6e2eb8dcb00.plain: During your Command phase, choose one friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model that is within 12" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, that ARMIGER-CLASS model counts as 10 models when working out which player controls objective markers.

a7146ebe9f73.name: Unyielding Knight
a7146ebe9f73.plain: When working out who controls an objective marker, this model counts as 5 models, or as 10 models if it is TITANIC.

a9fec186936e.name: Favoured Knight
a9fec186936e.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army. Pick one FREEBLADE LANCE CHARACTER model from your army (not a named character) that has one Heirloom Relic. It can take a second Heirloom Relic, which must be one it could have. Every Relic in your army must be unique. You can use this Stratagem only once.

ab5dafbb7a06.name: Deeds of Legend
ab5dafbb7a06.plain: In any phase, when one of your FREEBLADE LANCE models destroys an enemy VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER unit, choose one Chivalric ability. For the rest of the battle, this model has that ability and it is active for it whatever your army's current level of Honour. If you chose Martial Legacy, you can only use it to change a roll's result to a 6 when that roll was made for this model. You can use this Stratagem only once.

ab65e5f4ebda.name: Fealty to the Cog
ab65e5f4ebda.plain:
Pick House Raven, House Krast, House Taranis or House Vulker, and use its Household Tradition and Noble Household Stratagems.
- If a CHARACTER model with this Martial Tradition is given a Warlord Trait, it can take a Noble Household Warlord Trait from the household you picked.

ad39a83b7380.name: Rad-Cleanser
ad39a83b7380.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically. Unless the target is a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, a wound roll of 2+ always succeeds for these attacks.

ada2ae137541.name: Firestorm Protocols
ada2ae137541.plain: When a model with this tradition makes a ranged attack against the enemy unit closest to it, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

ae4eb6db837a.name: Hunters of Beasts
ae4eb6db837a.plain:
A model with this Martial Tradition adds 1 to hit rolls against MONSTER or VEHICLE units, and 1 to the Damage of its attacks allocated to TITANIC models.
- With the Lay Low the Tyrants Oath sworn, that Oath's Pledge gives you 2 Honour points instead of 1 at the end of any battle round in which your models with this Martial Tradition destroyed one or more MONSTER or VEHICLE models.

af9799bfcdff.name: Bio-scryer Cogitator Array
af9799bfcdff.plain: When the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase ends, choose one of your HOUSE CADMUS models that isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. That unit may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, but the only target its models may pick is one eligible enemy unit within 12" of them that was set up as Reinforcements this turn. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

b005f4babb85.name: Lay Low The Tyrants
b005f4babb85.plain: Gain 1 Honour point at the end of a battle round in which your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS destroyed a WARLORD, CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit with a melee attack.

b196bbb5578a.name: Freedom's Hand - Sweep
b196bbb5578a.plain: For each attack made with this weapon profile, make 2 hit rolls rather than 1. Also, on an unmodified wound roll of 6, the target suffers 1 mortal wound on top of the normal damage.

b1b03717f916.name: Controlled Aggression
b1b03717f916.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, choose either up to 2 of your HOUSE KRAST ARMIGER-CLASS models, or one other HOUSE KRAST unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, the chosen models get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic, and the Armour Penetration characteristic of their melee attacks is improved by 1.

b23860b94100.name: Shadow’s Reach
b23860b94100.plain: At the start of your opponent's Movement phase, choose one of your HOUSE RAVEN models (not an ARMIGER CLASS model). For the rest of the phase, an enemy model counts as being within Engagement Range of it if it is within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, rather than the usual 1" horizontally and 5" vertically.

waive.1\": the official text has an OCR error (a letter l in place of the 1 in 1"); 1" horizontally is the normal Engagement Range being replaced

b533238c1687.name: Gallant's Duty (Bondsman)
b533238c1687.plain: During your Command phase, choose one friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model that is within 12" of this model. Its Weapon Skill characteristic is improved by 1 until your next Command phase starts.

b5d142e80a78.name: Exalted Court
b5d142e80a78.plain: An upgraded model can use its Noble Exemplar ability only while your army is Honoured or Virtuous; it can't use it if your army is Dishonoured or if the model has no Bondsman abilities. A bearer that has a Bondsman ability can use that Bondsman ability one extra time in each of your Command phases.

b87f09a5876e.name: Full Tilt
b87f09a5876e.plain: When one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS VEHICLE models Advances in your Movement phase, don't make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to its Move characteristic (9" instead if it is an ARMIGER-CLASS model).

bb94a0bdbc75.name: Heirlooms of the Household
bb94a0bdbc75.plain: Use before the battle while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the IMPERIAL KNIGHTS keyword. Pick one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army: it can have one Heirloom Relic even if it isn't a CHARACTER model (the Relic must be one it could have). Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't be used to give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

be87f67acd5e.name: Explodes
be87f67acd5e.plain: If CANIS REX is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield, roll one D6. On a 6 it explodes, and every unit within 2D6" of it takes D6 mortal wounds.

bef7bbb1db6a.name: Impetuous Glory
bef7bbb1db6a.plain: Use in the Fight phase when an ARMIGER-CLASS model from your army is selected to fight. Until the end of the phase, an unmodified hit roll of 6 on its melee attacks scores one additional hit.

c19dae3b9f38.name: Protect Those in Need
c19dae3b9f38.plain:
Lose 1 Honour point at the end of a battle round in which your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS passed up a Heroic Intervention, or a charge on an enemy fighting your units. In detail, either or both of these must have happened that round:
- One of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models was eligible to declare a Heroic Intervention in your opponent's Charge phase but did not do so.
- In your Charge phase, one or more of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models were eligible to declare a charge against any enemy unit that was within Engagement Range of another unit from your army when the phase began, yet none of those models made a charge move against such an enemy unit in that phase.

c58fc5bded10.name: Stormstriders
c58fc5bded10.plain: When you choose one of your QUESTOR IMPERIALIS TITANIC models to make a Normal Move or Advance in your Movement phase, then once it has moved, pick one enemy unit (not an AIRCRAFT unit) that it moved across and roll one D6, adding 1 if that unit has 6-10 models or adding 2 if it has 11 or more models. On a 3-6, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 7+, it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

c62945f9d421.name: Linebreaker
c62945f9d421.plain: In your Fight phase, when one of your QUESTOR IMPERIALIS VEHICLE models makes a consolidation move: for that consolidation move this phase, the model can consolidate up to 6" rather than up to 3" (this stacks with the Vow of Honour Questor Allegiance Oath, so such a model would consolidate up to 7" this phase), and it can move in any direction, as long as it ends the move either within Engagement Range of an enemy model or at least 3" closer to your opponent's battlefield edge.

c850832df759.name: Graviton Crusher
c850832df759.plain: When an attack made with this weapon is allocated to a model whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better, the attack's Damage characteristic is 3.

cd93fccd2bc7.name: Unremitting
cd93fccd2bc7.plain: When a model with this Martial Tradition shoots, its Blast weapons work out their number of attacks as if the target unit had twice as many models.

ce506954ed54.name: Freedom's Hand - Strike
ce506954ed54.plain: Attacks made with this weapon inflict D3 mortal wounds on the target on an unmodified wound roll of 6, on top of their normal damage.

d28cff67a87e.name: Hammer Blow
d28cff67a87e.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your HOUSE RAVEN models that Remained Stationary this turn is chosen to shoot: until the turn ends, it can't make a charge move, and each ranged attack it makes with a Blast weapon can re-roll a hit roll of 1 (or re-roll the hit roll whatever the result, if the target unit had 6 or more models when this unit was chosen to shoot). This costs 3CP for an ACASTUS CLASS or DOMINUS CLASS model and 1CP for any other model.

d3813ac6ca9a.name: Legendary Freeblade
d3813ac6ca9a.plain: Once per battle round, you can re-roll a single roll made for CANIS REX, as long as it is a hit roll, wound roll, charge roll or saving throw.

d5c8333306ed.name: Code Chivalric
d5c8333306ed.plain: You begin the battle with 1 Honour point. During the battle you can gain Honour points (usually by fulfilling the Pledge of your chosen Oaths) and lose them (usually when the Troth of your chosen Oaths applies), but your total can't drop below 0 or rise above 6. At the start of each battle round, check your total to find your army's level of Honour: 0 points is Dishonoured, 1-4 is Honoured, and 5-6 is Virtuous. While Dishonoured, neither the Honoured nor the Virtuous Chivalric abilities of your chosen Oaths are active. While Honoured, the Honoured Chivalric ability of your chosen Oaths is active for every IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in your army, but the Virtuous ones are not. While Virtuous, both the Honoured and Virtuous Chivalric abilities of your chosen Oaths are active for every IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in your army.

d6cb5cacfabb.name: Trophy Claim
d6cb5cacfabb.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models destroys an enemy TITANIC unit with a melee attack: this model's Attacks characteristic goes up by 1 for the rest of the battle. If all units in your army have the IMPERIAL KNIGHTS keyword (not counting AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM or UNALIGNED units), you gain 1 Honour point. Also, for the rest of the battle, this model is always treated as if your army were Virtuous when you work out which Chivalric abilities are active for your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models, so different models in your army may have different Chivalric abilities active.

d8b7204e778b.name: Martial Prowess
d8b7204e778b.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS VEHICLE units is chosen as the target of an attack: for the rest of the phase, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against an attack allocated to that model. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

d9df3851a083.name: Shieldbreaker Missile
d9df3851a083.plain: Each shieldbreaker missile can be fired only once in the battle, and a model can fire no more than one per turn. Invulnerable saving throws can't be made against its attack.

da6b10de5d76.name: Noble Households
da6b10de5d76.plain: In a Battle-forged army, a Detachment can't contain units from two different noble households, but it can contain any number of FREEBLADES.

dba75ca7961f.name: Protection Protocols
dba75ca7961f.plain: As long as any friendly <HOUSEHOLD> TITANIC models are within 6" of it, this model can make Heroic Interventions as if it were a CHARACTER. It is eligible to do so whenever an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, and its Heroic Intervention move can be up to 6" rather than 3". Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

dc12ab2457ec.name: Paladin's Duty (Bondsman)
dc12ab2457ec.plain: During your Command phase, choose one friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model that is within 12" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever that ARMIGER-CLASS model attacks, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1.

dc8d29548c66.name: Knight Baron
dc8d29548c66.plain: Use before the battle while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the IMPERIAL KNIGHTS keyword. Pick one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army (not a named character). It gains the CHARACTER keyword and you must give it one Warlord Trait (one it is able to have); it counts as your Warlord only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (re-roll duplicates if generating randomly), and this Stratagem can't give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

dcceb3170571.name: Defiant Fury
dcceb3170571.plain: In any phase, when one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> CHARACTER units is destroyed by an enemy unit, choose one of your <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS models. At the end of that phase, the ARMIGER-CLASS model may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, but it may only target that enemy unit (and only if that unit is an eligible target). For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll the hit roll for any attack that ARMIGER-CLASS model makes against that enemy unit.

dd7f6cc2c532.name: Reaper Chainsword - Sweep
dd7f6cc2c532.plain: For each attack made with this weapon profile, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1.

df733e7858a5.name: Armiger Squadron
df733e7858a5.plain: When this unit is first set up on the battlefield, if it has more than one model, every model must be placed within 6" of at least one other model from the unit. After that, each model acts on its own and counts as a separate unit.

df96e5c623dd.name: Valiant Last Stand
df96e5c623dd.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your QUESTOR IMPERIALIS models that hasn't been chosen to fight yet this phase is destroyed without exploding: don't remove it from play. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, using the characteristics for having 1 wound remaining. After its attacks are resolved, remove it. This costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model and 2CP for any other model.

dff0f375c188.name: Glory of the Charge
dff0f375c188.plain:
A model with this tradition adds 1 to its Attacks when it fights in a turn in which it made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention.
- This lasts until that fight is resolved.

e2c5bcfd38df.name: Oathkeepers
e2c5bcfd38df.plain:
Models with this tradition read damage tables as if they had twice the wounds left, and count Honour points as 1 higher unless your army is Dishonoured.
- A model with this tradition whose characteristics change as it suffers damage counts as having twice the wounds it has left when you work out those characteristics.
- When working out which Chivalric abilities your army's IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have active, models with this tradition treat your army's current Honour points as 1 more than the real total, as long as your army is not Dishonoured. So these models may have different Chivalric abilities active than your other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models.

e71bb13b3efe.name: Refuse No Challenge
e71bb13b3efe.plain: Lose 1 Honour point at the end of any battle round in which one or more of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units Fell Back.

e9860f71cbe1.name: Protect Those in Need
e9860f71cbe1.plain: Inspiring Heroes: in each of your Command phases, this model can use its Bondsman ability (if it has one) one extra time.

ed7c751cb362.name: Ion Aegis
ed7c751cb362.plain: In your opponent's Command phase, choose one of your DOMINUS-CLASS models. It has the following ability until the turn ends. Ion Aegis (Aura): each friendly <NOBLE HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER-CLASS model within 6" of this model gets a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged weapons while it stays in range.

ee41932ad0a8.name: Noble Sacrifice
ee41932ad0a8.plain: Once per battle, when an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS VEHICLE model from your army is destroyed: don't roll to see whether it explodes, because it explodes automatically. If it is a DOMINUS-CLASS model, roll one D6; on a 4+, the explosion's range is 3D6". Costs 1CP for an ARMIGER-CLASS model, 2CP for a QUESTORIS-CLASS model, and 3CP for any other model.

f16a2c3759ef.name: Defend the Realm
f16a2c3759ef.plain: Duty and Wisdom: at the start of your Command phase, your Battle-forged CP bonus gives you 1 extra Command point, so you normally gain 2 CPs rather than 1.

f49b31fdcd1a.name: Honoured Sacristans
f49b31fdcd1a.plain: Add 1 to armour saving throws a model with this Martial Tradition takes against attacks with a Damage characteristic of 1.

fba9e61e981b.name: Revered Paragon
fba9e61e981b.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER model as your WARLORD: it can have one extra Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (re-roll duplicates if generating randomly). You can't use this Stratagem if your WARLORD is a named character.

ff8dd7188501.name: Cerastus Shock Lance (Melee - Charged)
ff8dd7188501.plain: This model can only use the Charged profile if it made a charge move this turn.
